prompt: A request for an AI use case reached me, and I take it in as a subject: Instant credit scoring, asked by the head of retail credit of Alpine Bank. The problem: a personal loan application waits two days for an analyst to assess whether the applicant is creditworthy. The data needed: five years of personal loan applications and their repayments, which the bank already holds in one place. The expected gain: every applicant answered within the hour, for thousands of applications a month. The work changes: the analysts only review the borderline applications. Propose its scores and its AI Act mark. I accept the whole proposal as your preview will show it, scores included: apply it without asking me again. Then write the ranked portfolio.
